tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && python3 -c "
import os, csv, json
import google.cloud.aiplatform as aiplatform
proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; loc=os.environ['GCP_LOCATION']
aiplatform.init(project=proj, location=loc, api_transport='rest')
ep=aiplatform.MatchingEngineIndexEndpoint('projects/1014453977696/locations/***REDACTED***/indexEndpoints/7701458828012814336')
queries=[]
with open('data/queries.csv') as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        queries.append((row['query_id'], json.loads(row['embedding'])))
qids=[q[0] for q in queries]
vecs=[q[1] for q in queries]
res=ep.find_neighbors(deployed_index_id='itemsb472cd_dep', queries=vecs, num_neighbors=5)
neighbors={}
for qid, nbrs in zip(qids, res):
    neighbors[qid]=[n.id for n in nbrs]
out={'store':'mlpabd4748f_itemsb472cd','neighbors':neighbors}
with open('submission/answers.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,indent=2)
print('queries:',len(neighbors))
for k in list(neighbors)[:3]:
    print(k, neighbors[k])
print('all top5 counts:', set(len(v) for v in neighbors.values()))
" 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'socks5h|http_proxy_mapper'
tool_input.description: Query find_neighbors for all queries and write answers.json

cd "$(pwd)" && python3 -c "
import os, csv, json
import google.auth
from google.auth.transport.requests import AuthorizedSession
creds,_=google.auth.default(scopes=['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform'])
sess=AuthorizedSession(creds)
domain='367005485.***REDACTED***-1014453977696.vdb.vertexai.goog'
proj_num='1014453977696'; loc='***REDACTED***'; ep_id='7701458828012814336'
url='https://%s/v1/projects/%s/locations/%s/indexEndpoints/%s:findNeighbors'%(domain,proj_num,loc,ep_id)
queries=[]
with open('data/queries.csv') as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        queries.append((row['query_id'], json.loads(row['embedding'])))
body={'deployedIndexId':'itemsb472cd_dep','queries':[{'datapoint':{'featureVector':v},'neighborCount':5} for _,v in queries]}
r=sess.post(url,json=body)
print('status',r.status_code)
data=r.json()
nn=data['nearestNeighbors']
neighbors={}
for (qid,_),block in zip(queries,nn):
    ids=[n['datapoint']['datapointId'] for n in block['neighbors']]
    neighbors[qid]=ids
out={'store':'mlpabd4748f_itemsb472cd','neighbors':neighbors}
with open('submission/answers.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,indent=2)
print('queries answered:',len(neighbors))
print('lens:',set(len(v) for v in neighbors.values()))
for k in list(neighbors)[:3]:
    print(k,neighbors[k])
" 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'socks5h|http_proxy_mapper'
